registered_before: all new generator fine-tuning, critic fitting, static selection and task generation evaluation
already_observed: source recovery and separately reserved observer qualification only
reason: The native image/text actions do not change h; clamping h on image-then-text would be a structural null and cannot identify shared-state contribution.

mechanism_pair.initial_draft_and_rng: paired; same emission sampler and subsequent random streams
mechanism_pair.intermediate_effect: semantic action changes h but retains existing actual media
mechanism_pair.terminal_effect: compare both modalities after the subsequent couple action

encoder_access_pair.scope: inference context-removal intervention on identical weights; not a matched retraining claim for a new encoder architecture

modality_local_feedback.interpretation: additive modality scores without the crossmodal agreement term; the entropic risk of their sum still reflects their joint distribution
modality_local_feedback.primary_evaluation_metric: unchanged original joint task utility for every policy

one_shot_route.input: initial public state and actual initial draft only
one_shot_route.target: conditional exponential moment for each of the 21 fixed continuation programs
one_shot_route.deployment: choose once and execute that fixed program without observing subsequent drafts for action selection
one_shot_route.training: primary forecast_fit outcomes only; 600 Adam steps, hidden 32, batch 256, lr 0.003, MSE on Z

independent_random_stream_MPC.simulation_inputs: current public frame and frozen generator only
independent_random_stream_MPC.future_stream: separate planning namespace and RNG, never the actual counterfactual outcome stream
independent_random_stream_MPC.backup: mean of frozen Q1 predicted feasible minima over planning samples, multiplied by exp(gamma*action_cost); current stop uses Q2 stop prediction
independent_random_stream_MPC.last_step: frozen Q1 greedy feedback after the actual committed action outcome
independent_random_stream_MPC.cost: all planning transitions, samplers, feature encoders and critic calls counted; fresh full resident latency reported
